remarks: Fractional ownership that would allow you to purchase 1 Fraction or have the option to purchase all 3. Ownership at the Tamarack Club allows you year 'round access to the heated indoor/outdoor pool, hot tubs, sauna, fitness center, private owner locker room, private owner lounge, underground parking while lodging overnight, valet parking, and discounts on golf and daily lift tickets. Ownership gives you 10-11 weeks per fraction, per year and they rotate every year. Renovations are underway and these units are slated to be completed in 2026!
